decisions.reason: The candidate has static policy/evidence validators but no executable candidate-owned controller path that launches and owns the pinned MCP stdio process, admits a structured request, forwards it, captures the real response, and proves exact cleanup. C3 therefore cannot exercise the required broker boundary without an uncertifiable bypass.
decisions.smallest_fix: Add one bounded S2 firmware acceptance controller entry point using the existing broker/policy/process/claim primitives, plus fake-stdio lifecycle and direct-capability-denial coverage.
decisions.complexity_and_risk: Moderate and contained behind the physical acceptance route; lower than the certain C3 block or topology violation without it.
